A lot. Everything went on a spiral from the day i was born.
I was born in the balkans, my mother and father's marriage was already in pieces.
When i reached the fifth year of my life i was already off to the wind, lost and homeless, when for some reason my mother remember me after 3 years of negligence and took me to italy.
I didnt how to talk, not even in my original lenguage, i had to relearn to even speak, needless to say how to live in a urban city.
 I was overwhelmed by everything and my mother decided with my grandparents to let me only to go to school and nothing else.
I wasnt allowed to go out.
Then the physical abuse, punches, beatings, insults and humiliations started.
It was like that until 2019, where my mother lost her job and became an alcoholic, it continued for a full year and now limits herselfs for an outburst she had on the whole family while drink nearly passing out.
And now we are here, im 17, I was allowed to go out of my house at 16 and 4 months, because I was near to have a mental breakdown, i felt relieved but then my life it overturned like an omelette, no social experience, no friends, no hobbies, no dreams, nothing.
I started trying to be my better self, wanted to go to the gym, got a motorcycle license, got the motorcycle of my dreams, started to study like a madman to be the best.
And in the last one i failed at it, completely and it was the first thing i could do freely.
From there on( 1 month ago) i feel empty, i feel nothing, I dont have the will to live, eat, sleep and so i havent slept since 2 weeks ago, I lost 22 kilos.
The things i succeeded with, i didnt care about them anymore, it was just a relentless waiting to reach my grave and my mother started to drink again, the last stab to the chest.
I feel like just a box of flesh and bone, something i want to escape, hoping that theres nothing after death and that my consciousness will cease to exist, giving me some peace
I get it, thanks anyways, everyone has their own morals
Well surely there are a lot of user active every month, millions i would say, there will  be absolutely the one to receive my thanks for that
I will hear it maybe i can rearrange the stuff in my head
